# A brass faucet: a block on the rim, a riser, a spout reaching over the water (-X), two knobs.
# Origin on the rim under the riser. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Brass --base-color 0.7294 0.5686 0.3451 --no-slot
material new Knob --base-color 0.8235 0.7882 0.6471 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Base --size 1 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 0.5 0.9 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name Riser --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 0.5
add mesh cube --name Spout --size 1 --location -0.4 0 0.82
scale 0.8 0.2 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Lip --size 1 --location -0.74 0 0.68
scale 0.16 0.2 0.3
apply --scale
select Base Riser Spout Lip
material assign Brass
add mesh cylinder --name KnobA --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0.42 0.3
add mesh cylinder --name KnobB --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.18 --location 0 -0.42 0.3
select KnobA KnobB
material assign Knob
select all
shade flat
export faucet.glb
